findings: Two fresh live baseline processes have max scroll intervals 38.189166 and 27.921541 ms. These are baseline observations on c6b62c77, not results of d86caf0ce.
First baseline publications show 33-37 ms preparations, concentrated at scrolling start.

Separate timing interposition records first replay at 23490 us, IOSurface allocations at 102-106 us, and later replay preparation near 1-3 ms. This narrows initial work but does not attribute every stall to the removed vector.
The expected-failure allocation control demonstrates that the new scene-memory test detects the former full-document step allocation. Regular and prealloc command/lifetime checks pass.
No retired-instruction savings credited; no broad-suite reset. This is one focused fix in this HN frame-tail followup; broad tests remain batched under AGENTS.md.
